name: Amanoma Fuuta
source:
Name: Futa Amanoma
Sex: Male
Age: 36 ([i]AI[/I]-[I]AINS[/I]) | 37 ([i]AINI[/i] Past) | 43 ([i]AINI[/i] Present)
Birthday: February 1
Profession: ABIS Engineer
Likes: Multiples of 16, Chairs, Tokoroten, Amore
Dislikes: Bugs, Cats, Conservatives, Cyclopes
Hobbies: Working with machines, Collecting doujins, Imitating Magical girls
Skills: Building models, Imitating vuvuzelas

In [i][url=/v26532]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/i]:
Pewter is ABIS’s engineer and a brilliant mechanic. Currently, he is responsible for maintaining the Psync machine and preparing Psyncs. He also invented Aiba (and set her personality to his liking).[spoiler]

In [i][url=/v55357]No Sleep For Kaname Date – From AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES[/url][/I]:
An ABIS engineer, mechanic, and all around a capable scientist. Though he was in charge of managing and optimizing the Psync machine, a crime he committed got him discharged and taken into detention.[/spoiler]

In [i][url=/v31469]AI: THE SOMNIUM FILES - nirvanA Initiative[/url][/i]:
An ABIS engineer and mechanic. His main job is operating and maintaining the Psync machine.
[Past]
[spoiler]He committed a crime in the past leading to his dismissal, but Boss pulled some strings to get his job back.[/spoiler]
[Present]
He created the AI-Balls (Aiba and Tama). He got his clothes off eHarbor.

[From the in-game character descriptions]

[spoiler]In [I]AI[/I], Pewter is Renju's lover, the one who gave him the watch as an anniversary gift. In [I]AINS[/I], he is hidden inside a medical pod and is given the monicker [b]Person of Interest I[/b] to hide his identity.[/spoiler]
